t: This is 48 Welbeck Street, a building in Westminster. Thomas Young lived here. He was a British polymath, someone who made real contributions across many fields: vision, light, solid mechanics, energy, physiology, language, musical harmony and Egyptology. He matters especially for his part in deciphering Egyptian hieroglyphs, working on the Rosetta Stone. So as you look at the front of this ordinary-seeming building, picture a man whose curiosity ranged from how the eye sees to how ancient scripts can be read.
